title: What Oren Left
summary: Oren was gone by morning. He left his bowl at your door and a note: 'Thank you. Whatever he became, he was a good boy once. Fill this for whoever walks the road next.'

goals.say: The elder takes the bread for the road-walkers. 'There's always someone,' she says. 'Thank you for remembering.'
goals.name: Village Elder

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: Is that a pilgrim's bowl? We get them on the road now and again. Hungry, always.
talk: An old man named Oren left it.
Oren? He's walked this road since I was a girl. He's looking for someone. I never asked who.
He taught a cult steward to count.
Then I hope the steward remembers something else he was taught. Teachers are owed that much.
